comment: Wave-1 (F0) PINNED external-tool manifest. Local certifiers (lean, z3, ollama) are referenced by ABSOLUTE path (never PATH). (2026-09-04, John) The cross-family PRIMARY seat is whichever family the Anchor dashboard prefs configure — review_family first, then coding_family, never the author's own; gemini ONLY when a pref names it (src/seat.mjs, reading the prefs through <path> loadModelFamilies). This manifest pins the TRANSPORT for every family a pref may name (tools.claude / gemini / grok / chatgpt: driver_ref + run_export) + the ollama-FALLBACK. The F0 probe runs the resolved PRIMARY seat first and each tool's integrity sentinels before any certifier is trusted. Local paths verified on this host 2026-06-22; cross-family moved to the agy transport 2026-07-06; seat resolution moved to Anchor prefs 2026-09-04.

cross_family.note: Substrate (2026-09-04): cross-family certification runs on the PREFS-RESOLVED seat (frontier tier, rung CORROBORATED after the frontier-canary self-test reproduces the normalized VERDICT) with ollama-FALLBACK (tier=fallback => PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED). A seat that is unreachable / times out / errors / is unconfigured, OR whose driver SUBSTITUTES or cannot ATTEST the served model, is QUARANTINED and the probe falls back; if the fallback ALSO fails its sentinel, the lift HARD-FAULTS to CONJECTURAL (never an un-probed backend, never a same-family pass).
cross_family.primary_resolution: Anchor prefs (data-dir settings.json -> ~/.anchor/model_prefs.json): the configured family among review_family / coding_family that is not the author's; none -> no seat (cross_model:false, honest) -> the ollama fallback tier

gemini.role: F1-cross-family-seat (only when a pref names gemini)
gemini.note: The gemini seat (used ONLY when review_family or coding_family names gemini): the Antigravity CLI `agy` through the user LOGIN, addressed by a human LABEL (never an API-style id, which agy silently degrades to Flash), via the proven transport at driver_ref with served-model ATTESTATION. Env-gated (CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1); the fast `node --test` gate injects a stub and spawns no agy.

grok.note: The Grok seat: the subscription Grok Build CLI (`grok.exe -p`, plan permission mode for a refuter) — never the raw xAI HTTP API. Env-gated (CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1).

chatgpt.note: The ChatGPT seat: the subscription Codex CLI (`codex exec`, read-only sandbox for a refuter) — never the raw OpenAI HTTP API. John's dashboard on 2026-09-04: coding_family=chatgpt, review_family=claude -> with a Claude author this IS the seat. Env-gated (CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1).

claude.role: F1-cross-family-seat (only for a claim NOT authored by Claude)
claude.note: The Claude seat: `claude.exe` (subscription). The Honesty Law is generator-relative — this seat is legal only when the claim's author is another family; the driver hard-faults otherwise. model=null: the driver picks its standard notch by role.

lean.note: Core Lean only; mathlib (multi-GB) FLAGGED follow-on. Verified 1+1=2 := rfl -> exit 0, 1+1=3 := rfl -> exit 1.

lake.note: Lean build driver; pinned for completeness. Core Lean only (no mathlib this increment).

z3.note: Used ONLY within z3-DECIDABLE theories (LIA/LRA/BV); quantified number-theory/analysis is out of scope this increment (fail-CLOSED on unknown). Verified sat/unsat.

ollama.note: Cross-family FALLBACK (non-Claude) verifier panel, used when the Gemini PRIMARY is quarantined (key-missing / 401|403 / 429 / unreachable). A weaker soft-check tier => PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED (NOT a proof oracle). A SINGLE cold generation measured >200s on this host, so a persistent server + a paid-once warm-up is REQUIRED; per-call model reload is forbidden. The bare `ollama run` default is NOT temp 0 — deterministic decoding is pinned below.

cross_family_probe.note: P8 probabilistic-class integrity: N=5 trials at deterministic decoding on a known-true + known-false battery (5/5 each) PLUS a proof-JUDGING sentinel (a planted plausible-but-wrong proof the panel MUST reject). A model that accepts the wrong proof is QUARANTINED from the PLAUSIBILITY-CORROBORATED path.

faithfulness_instance_battery.comment: Wave-4 (F2+F3) reads this. The metamorphic concrete-instance battery is tool/cross-family/human/PRNG-sourced (NEVER Claude-enumerated), provenance-stamped, coupled to a non-vacuity check.
